name: Act Floor Customizer
author: Bobojo
description: Add 0-50 extra floors to Acts 1, 2 and 3 through BaseLib's in-game config page. Long maps keep the vanilla room spacing and the parchment stretches with them, a row of treasure rooms can be added every N rows, and the share of unknown rooms, shops, rest sites and elites can be tuned. In co-op the host's values apply to everyone.
